description: Render a public web page in Chromium and return a screenshot. Use fullPage for the whole scrollable page; very tall pages come back as a link instead of an inline image, and a fullPage WebP capture of a page taller than 16383px is clipped to that height (reported as fullPageClip) — use jpeg or png for pages that tall.

format.description: Image format. webp and jpeg are much smaller than png.

height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels. Values above the service maximum are clamped.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to capture, e.g. 'https://example.com'.

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector that must appear before capturing.

waitUntil.description: Navigation event to wait for before capturing.

width.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels. Values above the service maximum are clamped.

name: take_screenshot
title: Take a screenshot
